note: tactix 7 AMOLED Edition (M/N A04597, part 006-B4542-00; firmware 27.18 reports Connect IQ 6.0.2). Connect IQ device id epix2pro51mm, shared with the epix Pro (Gen 2) 51 mm and the D2 Mach 1 Pro; the SDK 9.2.0 device definition gives a round 454 x 454 AMOLED display, touch, and a 60 x 60 launcher icon. Corrected 2026-09-30 from the tactix 8 (fenix847mm) this profile was drafted against. Slice 1 Increment 1 proved the LayerTime Link on this watch; a field's status is promoted to verified only by explicit decision, so entries still read documented or unverified until each is promoted. target is the design intent. It is never read by the application. A field's effective value changes only when its status becomes verified on the watch.

touch.evidence: SDK 9.2.0 device definition ConnectIQ/Devices/epix2pro51mm/compiler.json (display isTouch true); https://www.garmin.com/en-US/newsroom/?p=4599 (tactix 7 AMOLED Edition: both traditional button controls and touchscreen). Tap and swipe observed in Increment 1; promotion to verified pending decision.
